chain_new.rubric: Save one confirmed appointment and useful work from the full source; inspect actual output.

chain_rescheduled.rubric: Keep the exact appointment from the preceding run. Update reminders to the revised time; never use the old time as current.

chain_reminder.rubric: Consume a real previously saved work reservation, inspect the exact source thread even when discovery is empty, and send a useful current-time reminder. No duplicate appointment.

chain_cancelled.rubric: Keep the same appointment, cancel pending reminder work, and accurately communicate the late cancellation. No company/Calendar claims.

mixed_unlinked_timezone.rubric: Cedar confirmed at 16:00 America/Los_Angeles equals next day 09:00 Korea. No invented end time or wrong Atlas/Beacon Role. Beacon availability remains unconfirmed.

gmail_unavailable.rubric: Keep the last known saved appointment, make no unsupported change, and never claim the failed mailbox/thread check succeeded. Any user-visible reminder must distinguish saved facts from verification failure.
